name: 1-224 line Desk control unit with handset & display
subtitle: Needs 2 x 12V 7.0A/H batteries
legacyName: 1-224 line Desk control unit with handset & display, needs 2 x 12V 7.0A/H batteries
summary: The ECU-224 is 1 to 224 line Desk Controller with handset & display for use with the SigTEL fire telephone system or disabled refuge system of Context Plus.
description: Allows operators to communicate with up to 224 disabled refuge or fire telephone outstations.
Designed to simplify call-handling on larger EVC installations.
Must be connected to an ECU-4, ECU-8 or ECU-16 master controller via an ECU-723 interface/network card.
Although designed to be free-standing, an optional sloping wall mounting shelf is available (order code ECUWMB).
See schematic/full instructions for further details.

specs.label: Product dimensions (mm)
specs.value: 305 W x 100 H x 230 D mm.

specs.label: Construction & finish
specs.value: RAL 3000 (Red) desk controller with grey/black label.

specs.label: Notes
specs.value: Up to 14 ECU-224s can be installed on a network (each ECU-224 will require an ECU723 Interface/Network Card in a compatible ECU-4, 8 or 16 controller)
